title: SBB Tiki Boat
specs: Brand new six-passenger Beachcat saltwater pontoon boat with thatched roof
90 HP Suzuki motor, quiet and powerful
Fully U.S. Coast Guard certified captains with years of local experience
No one under 18 allowed on board
No one under 21 permitted to consume alcohol; ID may be requested
Boat capacity limited to six passengers plus crew by U.S. Coast Guard regulations
Suitable for friends, family, couples, bachelor/bachelorette parties, and other gatherings up to six passengers

services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: All cruises are Bring Your Own Food and Bring Your Own Beverage. Guests must be 21 or older to consume

includes: Life jackets for every passenger and crew member
U.S. Coast Guard required safety equipment
Bluetooth compatible sound system for music
gap: Price per person or group not stated
blurb: Guests board a six-passenger Beachcat saltwater pontoon boat with a thatched roof and Bluetooth sound system. Cruises last mostly two hours, with options for 90-minute tours. The boat has a restroom and all required U.S. Coast Guard safety equipment, and captains are fully certified and experienced.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made and acknowledged at least 48 hours in advance for full refund · No refund for cancellations within 48 hours or no-shows · SBB Tiki reserves right to cancel tours due to weather, safety, or mechanical issues with refund or reschedule · No refund for behavioral or alcohol related issues; tour may be ended early · Beach Haven Yacht Club Marina, 20 S West Avenue, Beach Haven NJ 08008
